findings.evidence: Contents (p.6–7) lists 'List of Figures . . . iv' as the only front-matter list; no 'List of Tables' entry appears. Tables in the body include (non-exhaustive) Table 1-1 (p.33), Table 2-1 (p.39), Table 2-2 (p.43), Table 3-1 (p.60), Table 3-2 (p.61), Table 3-3 (p.72), Table 4-1 (p.78), Table 4-2 (p.91), Table 5-1 (p.115), Table 5-2 (p.117), Table 6-1 (p.137), Table 7-1 (p.147), Table 7-2 (p.154), Table 7-3 (p.165), Table 8-1 (p.180).
findings.issue: The front matter provides a 'List of Figures' (pp.8–10) but no corresponding 'List of Tables', despite at least fifteen numbered tables that readers and cross-references rely on (e.g., 'Table 4-2' is cited dozens of times across chapters as the canonical provenance ledger). The omission makes it impossible to locate a table by number without scanning the whole book, and it is inconsistent with the front-matter convention established by the figure list.
findings.fix_instruction: Add a 'List of Tables' after the List of Figures (and a Contents entry for it), listing every Table N-M with its caption and printed page number.

findings.evidence: "Every quantitative value here is one of three kinds: a dated measurement, a figure derived from cited inputs, or is explicitly identified as an illustrative assumption (see the Sources, Method, and Reproducibility chapter for the full evidence taxonomy)."
findings.issue: The copyright page states quantitative values come in 'three kinds', but the Preface evidence panel (p.18) presents 'four registers' (MEASURED, ANALYTICAL, ILLUSTRATIVE, HYPOTHESIS) and the Preface axis definitions (pp.19) add a fifth epistemic state (UNRESOLVED) plus a third axis of measurement statuses (ANALYTICAL / SCENARIO-DERIVED / MODELED / MEASURED / UNMEASURED). The 'three kinds' summary is a simplification of a system the Preface itself describes as multi-axis; a careful reader comparing the two passages sees different counts (3 vs 4 vs 6+) for the same taxonomy. The mismatch is small but it is the very kind of internal inconsistency the book's evidence discipline is meant to prevent.
findings.fix_instruction: Either change 'three kinds' to match the Preface's actual taxonomy (e.g., 'three provenance/status categories, with additional measurement-status labels defined in …') or add a parenthetical noting the copyright-page list is a simplified summary and the Preface/Sources chapter defines the full label set.

findings.evidence: Cover: "AI · SYSTEMS" / "ARCHITECTUREHANDBOOK" (rendered image page 1 shows 'ARCHITECTUREHANDBOOK' as a single run with the spacing collapsed); body text on p. 22 renders the same masthead as "A I · S Y S T E M S" / "A R C H I T E C T U R E H A N D B O O K" with an odd gap before HANDBOOK.
findings.issue: Typography defect in the masthead: the word 'ARCHITECTURE' is run together with 'HANDBOOK' (missing word space) on the cover, and on the Ch. 1 opening page the letter-spacing is applied to 'ARCHITECTURE' but 'HANDBOOK' renders with a visible double-space gap ('ARCHITECTURE  HANDBOOK'). The two renderings of the identical masthead are inconsistent, and the cover version has no word boundary at all.
findings.fix_instruction: Set the cover masthead as 'AI · SYSTEMS' / 'ARCHITECTURE HANDBOOK' with an explicit space (or a consistent tracking rule applied to both words), and make the cover and the Part I opener render the masthead identically.

findings.evidence: Rendered cover (page 1 image), second letter-spaced display line: "A R C H I T E C U R E H A N D B O O K" — i.e. "ARCHITECUREHANDBOOK". The PDF text layer for the same page spells it "A R C H I T E C T U R E H A N D B O O K" (ARCHITECTUREHANDBOOK).
findings.issue: The printed cover subtitle misspells "ARCHITECTURE" (a "T" is missing in the rendered display type), while the invisible text layer carries the correct spelling — so the defect is visible in print but not in copy/paste or search.
findings.fix_instruction: Correct the cover art's display type to "ARCHITECTUREHANDBOOK" (or re-set it from the correct text-layer string) and re-render the cover.

findings.evidence: PDF p. 5: "Full terms: github.com/zhiqitao/from-token-to-fleet (LICENSE, SPDX LicenseRef-ZhiqiResearch-FromTokenToFleet-1.0)"; later: "The link above resolves that commit’s LICENSE file directly, so the terms quoted here can be read in their exact published form without locating the revision elsewhere."
findings.issue: The visible link text points to the repository root and parenthetical LICENSE name, not to the pinned commit’s LICENSE file, yet the prose says the link resolves directly to that file. A reader following the visible URL cannot read the exact pinned terms without manually substituting the commit path.
findings.fix_instruction: Either print the direct URL to github.com/zhiqitao/from-token-to-fleet/blob/<commit>/LICENSE or change the sentence to say that the repository link leads to the revision where the LICENSE file can be found.

findings.evidence: License. This work — the book text, diagrams, figures, and build scripts — is distributed under the source-available grant stated below.
findings.issue: Copyright page defines operative license as LICENSE file in repository at commit 27f4cd571d53ecb2ac549d5825a77c87f8736ad3 but does not reproduce license text; summary permissions (personal non-commercial verbatim redistribution) may conflict with authoritative LICENSE and creates ambiguity for PDF-only buyer without repo access.
findings.fix_instruction: Add SPDX identifier line verbatim and note that summary is non-operative; provide direct URL to raw LICENSE at pinned commit.

findings.issue: Contents lists List of Figures at page iv but PDF front-matter pagination truncated; List of Tables is missing entirely though tables (4-2, 1-1, 2-2 etc) exist, navigation aid incomplete.
findings.fix_instruction: Add List of Tables with page numbers and verify LoF page numbers match actual figure captions.
